p2_b0.ocr: The analysis of predictors of well-being is essential for understanding the factors that contribute to individuals' overall quality of life. In the accompanying table, several key metrics are presented, including the coefficients (b) and standard errors (SE) for each predictor variable examined. These metrics provide insights into the strength and significance of the relationships between various predictors and overall well-being.

p2_b1.ocr: For instance, the statistical significance of predictors can be assessed through the t- values and associated p-values, allowing researchers to identify which factors are most influential in enhancing well-being outcomes. Moreover, the effect size, represented by the f² metric, offers a quantitative measure of how substantially each predictor contributes to the model, thereby indicating the practical relevance of these findings.
